initial_failures.title: iOS home can reach its last action above the dock on portrait phones

browser_release_run.resolution: Home scroll test waited for font loading and native resize layout before choosing the document end. Corrected case passed six repeats, three per Chromium project. No source change was needed for this test timing issue.

browser_broad_run.resolution: Existing iOS shell test expected a 58px key despite the 3.0.4 responsive 44–60px range. Corrected assertion passed both projects in the release run.

handover_flow.limitations: Git and file preservation exercised on Linux; npm install/sync and macOS toolchain validation stubbed in these isolated fixtures. Real release build separately validated.

native_validation: GitHub CI is the native compile/archive gate; no local Xcode or physical Duo validation claimed.
